title: 3.8.17 Chart the Code: Save/Load Round Trip End to End
description: Draw the whole save-and-load pattern: stringify to save, read the key, decide whether anything was stored, parse inside a try, and fall back to defaults. Get both decision exits right.

aiGrader.prompt: This chart is scored entirely by rules from its shapes and arrows. No model reads it.

rubric.title: Read the key, check for nothing, then check the parse
rubric.description: Scored by the editor (arrow order): a task, then a decision, then a second decision, on every route.

steps.fail: Load asks two questions in order: first "is anything stored?", then "did the parse succeed?". Put the missing-key question first, and the parse question after it.
steps.pass: The missing-key check comes before the parse check.

rubric.title: Nothing stored leads to the defaults, not to the parse
rubric.description: Scored by the editor: one of the first decision's exits leads straight to a task (the defaults), the other to the second decision.

steps.fail: The first diamond has two different exits: one goes straight to a task that returns the defaults, the other goes on to the parse question.
steps.pass: One exit returns the defaults, the other goes on to the parse question.

rubric.title: Every path ends at the print
rubric.description: Scored by the editor: an input/output step for the print, after the decisions.

steps.fail: All the paths finish at one print. Draw an input/output step for the print.
Every path must pass the decisions and then the print before End.
steps.pass: Every path passes the decisions, then the print, then End.

rubric.title: The print says what came back
rubric.description: Scored by the editor: the input/output shape is about the restored value.

steps.fail: Say in the print step what it shows: the restored value.
steps.pass: The print step says what it shows.

gate.fail: None of your shapes say what this program does. Label each shape in your own words.
